posix-sh-single-quote-semantics.notes: NEW: POSIX sh single-quotes pass \ literally — no backslash escaping needed inside them. replace('\\','\\\\') before single-quote escape is WRONG and corrupts passwords with backslashes.

response-type-validation.notes: NEW: External API responses must be type-checked before iteration. REST API heuristic ('slug' in body) fired on error JSON dict, causing AttributeError on str.get(). Fix: parse JSON first, isinstance(parsed, list) before loop.
